ne17:1.2: “ekattatāya dhammā ye pi ca vemattatāya niddiṭṭhā” ti.
ne17:2.1: ye tattha niddiṭṭhā tathā te dhārayitabbā.
ne17:3.3: jāti dukkhā, jarā dukkhā, vyādhi dukkho, maraṇaṃ dukkhaṃ, appiyehi sampayogo dukkho, piyehi vippayogo dukkho, yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ, saṅkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā: rūpā dukkhā, vedanā dukkhā, saññā dukkhā, saṅkhārā dukkhā, viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ’.
ne17:5.3: yo tassāyeva taṇhāya asesavirāganirodho cāgo paṭinissaggo mutti anālayo.’
ne17:6.5: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.’
ne17:7.3: nirayagāmī maggo tiracchānayonigāmī maggo pettivisayagāmī maggo asurayonigāmiyo maggo saggagāmiyo magego manussagāmī maggo nibbānagāmī maggo’.
ne17:8.3: paṭisaṅkhā nirodho, appaṭisaṅkhānirodho, anunayanirodho, paṭighanirodho, mānanirodho, makkhanirodho, palāsanirodho, issānirodho, macchariyanirodho, sabbakilesanirodho.
ne17:9.3: cātummahābhūtikaṃ rūpaṃ catunnaṃ ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpassa paññatti.
ne17:10.1: dvīhi ākārehi dhātuyo parigaṇhāti saṅkhepena ca vitthārena ca.
ne17:10.3: vīsatiyā ākārehi paṭhavīdhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti. dvādasahi ākārehi āpodhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti. catūhi ākārehi tejodhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti. chahi ākārehi vāyodhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti.
ne17:11.1: katamehi vīsatiyā ākārehi paṭhavīdhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti:
ne17:11.2: ‘atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahārū aṭṭhī aṭṭhimiñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ matthaluṅganti. imehi vīsatiyā ākārehi paṭhavīdhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti.
ne17:12.1: katamehi dvādasahi ākārehi āpodhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti:
ne17:12.2: ‘atthi imasmiṃ kāye pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttanti. imehi dvādasahi ākārehi āpodhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti.
ne17:13.1: katamehi catūhi ākārehi tejodhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti:
ne17:13.2: ‘yena ca santappati yena ca jīrīyati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāhitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchatī’ti, imehi catūhi ākārehi tejodhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti.
ne17:14.1: katamehi chahi ākārehi vāyodhātu vitthārena parigaṇhāti:
ne17:14.2: ‘uddhaṃgamā vātā adhogamā vātā kucchisayā vātā koṭṭhasayā vātā aṅgamaṅgānusārino vātā assāso passāso iti’ imehi chahi ākārehi vāyodhātuṃ vitthārena parigaṇhāti.
ne17:15.1: evaṃ imehi dvāvattārīsāya ākārehi vitthārena dhātuyo sahāvabhāvato upalakkhayanto tulayanto pariyogāhanto parivīmaṃsanto paccavekkhanto na kiñci gayhūpagaṃ passati kāyaṃ vā kāyapadesaṃ vā: yathā candanikaṃ pavicinanto na kiñci gayhūpagaṃ passeyya, yathā saṅkhāradhānaṃ pavicinanto na kiñci gayhūpagaṃ passeyya, yathā vaccakuṭiṃ pavivīnanto na kiñci gayhūpagaṃ passeyya, yathā sīvathikaṃ pavicinanto na kiñci gayhūpagaṃ passeyya,
ne17:15.2: evamevaṃ imehi dvāvattārīsāya ākārehi evaṃ vitthārena dhātuyo sahāvabhāvato upalakkhayanto tulayanto pariyogāhanto parivīmaṃsanto paccavekkhanto na kiñci gayhūpagaṃ passati kāyaṃ vā kāyapadesaṃ vā.
ne17:15.3: tenāha bhagavā: “yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā paṭhavīdhātu yā ca bāhirā paṭhavīdhātu, paṭhavīkhāturevesā
ne17:15.4: taṃ netaṃ mama neso’hamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā paṭhavīdhātuyā nibbindati paṭhavīdhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
ne17:15.5: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā āpodhātu yā ca bāhirā āpodhātu, …pe…
ne17:15.6: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā tejodhātu yā ca bāhirā tejodhātu …pe…
ne17:15.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā vāyodhātu yā ca bāhirā vāyodhātu, vāyodhāturevesā
ne17:15.8: taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ. evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā vāyodhātuyā nibbindati vāyodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
ne17:16.3: dukkhe aññāṇaṃ dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ pubbante aññāṇaṃ aparante aññāṇaṃ pubbantāparante aññāṇaṃ idappaccayatāpaṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu aññāṇaṃ. yaṃ evarūpaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asallakkhaṇā anupalakkhaṇā apaccupalakkhaṇā asamapekkhaṇaṃ apaccakkhakammaṃ dummejjhaṃ bālyaṃ asampajaññaṃ moho pamoho sammoho avijjā avijjogho avijjāyogo avijjānusayo avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ,
ne17:17.3: dukkhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ pubbante ñāṇaṃ aparante ñāṇaṃ pubbantāparante ñāṇa idappaccayatāpaṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu ñāṇaṃ. yā evarūpā paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicaye sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhavyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūri medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññāāloko paññāobhāso paññāpajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicaya sambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ.’
ne17:19.3: atthi sekho jhāyi, atthi asekho jhāyi, atthi nevasekho nāsekho jhāyī, ājānīyo jhāyi, assakhaluṅko jhāyī, diṭṭhuttaro jhāyī, taṇhuttaro jhāyī, paññūttaro jhāyīti.

ne17:21.3: āgāḷhā paṭipadā, nijjhāmā paṭipadā, majjhimā paṭipadā, akkhamā paṭipadā, khamā paṭipadā, samā paṭipadā, damā paṭipadā, dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā, dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā’ti.
ne17:22.5: kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjā vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttaṃ matthaluṅganti.
ne17:22.7: nāmakāyo nāma vedanā saññā cetanā cittaṃ phasso manasikāroti
ne17:23.1: evaṃ yo dhammo yassa dhammassa samānabhāvo, so dhammo tassa dhammassa ekattatāya ekībhavatī,
ne17:23.2: yena yena vā pana vilakkhaṇo tena tena vemattataṃ gacchati.
ne17:23.3: evaṃ sutte vā veyyākaraṇe vā gāthāyaṃ vā pucchitena vīmaṃsitabbaṃ, kiṃ ekattatāya pucchati udāhu vemattatāyāti.
ne17:23.8: yathā yathā vā pana pucchitaṃ. yathā yathā vissajjayitabbaṃ.
